    The Euler form of a directing module (main theorem) #

    Fix a directing module M. An indecomposable is good if it is a projective summand, a predecessor of M, or isomorphic to M; good modules have no nonsplit extensions by M (DirGood.extVanish). The summands of the syzygy of a good module are good (good_syz). Covering a module with good summands summand by summand and inducting on depth gives ⟨dim Z, dim M⟩ = dim Hom(Z, M) (euler_good), in particular χ(dim M) = dim End M (euler_directing; ASS IX.1.4–1.5).
